html: † מַשׁ n.pr.loc. vel gent. מַ֑שׁ Gn 10:23, as son of Aram, Sam. משא; 𝔊 Μοσοχ; so read in ‖ 1 Ch 1:17 for MT מֶ֑שֶׁךְ A 𝔊L Μοσοχ; v Kau Kit. Loc. dub. Bö Mich Mons Mas-ius, N. of Nisibis (between Armen. and Mesop.), but name not certainly old Aramaic (unknown in Assyrian) cf. Diad loc. Assyrian Maš (Syro-Arabic desert DlPar 242f.) is hardly poss., cf. מֵשָׁא.
